questions.prompt: How should Homebrew be installed on macOS?
options: A. Copy a script from an unknown website
B. Follow official instructions and an authorized process
questions.answer: B. Follow official instructions and an authorized process
questions.explanation:
B. Follow official instructions and an authorized process

Official instructions help verify the source and required steps.

questions.prompt: What should you check before removing a package?
options: A. Its effect on user data and other applications
questions.answer: A. Its effect on user data and other applications
questions.explanation:
A. Its effect on user data and other applications

Removing software can affect its data and dependent applications.

questions.prompt: Where should applications be installed from?
